# Dhruvija Properties

> Bengaluru-rooted real estate developer since 1974. Managed farm plots, plotted layouts and skyline residences designed with eco-conscious detail. Named after Dhruva, the steadfast pole star.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dhruvijapropertieswebsite.lovable.app/): Overview of Dhruvija Properties, our offerings and featured projects.
- [About / Pole Star](https://dhruvijapropertieswebsite.lovable.app/about): Vision, philosophy, five-decade journey and the people behind Dhruvija.
- [Projects](https://dhruvijapropertieswebsite.lovable.app/projects): Current and past projects, managed farmlands, plotted communities and residences across Bengaluru.
- [Journal](https://dhruvijapropertieswebsite.lovable.app/journal): The Grove Journal, field notes and buyer guides on land, homes and living well in Bengaluru.
- [Gallery](https://dhruvijapropertieswebsite.lovable.app/gallery): Photographs of projects, spaces and moments across Bengaluru.
- [Connect](https://dhruvijapropertieswebsite.lovable.app/contact): Office in Seshadripuram, Bengaluru. Phone +91 95356 24443, email crm@dhruvija.com.

## Company

- Founded: 1974
- Location: Saroja Chamber, Seshadripuram, Bengaluru, India
- Focus: Eco-conscious real estate, managed farm plots, plotted layouts, premium residences.
